items.problem: Verbatim SDK-sample placeholder <Image Source="" /> on the first page navigated at startup fail-fasts the app at XAML load in WinUI 3 (0xC0000409); UWP tolerated it. App never renders -> score 0. Undocumented in the skill.
items.evidence: Scenario1.xaml:43 and Scenario2.xaml:53 contain Source=""; migration-score.json winui_launchable=false, both features fail; lessons.json errors_encountered[0].
items.root_cause: XAML migration guidance treats copied XAML as safe once xmlns/resources are rewritten, but does not cover value-level incompatibilities: an empty string for a typed property (ImageSource/Uri) runs the converter at load and is an invalid URI in WinUI 3.
items.change: Added a WARN-only check to Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 (Section 1b) that flags every non-deferred XAML `Source=""` with file:line and the fix; documented the empty-string typed-placeholder pitfall in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#xaml.
items.expected_effect: The validator names the exact load-fatal placeholder, so the agent removes it instead of chasing the SDK/runtime; the startup crash disappears.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-run: Validate-UwpMigration prints '[WARN] N empty-string Source= placeholder(s)' listing Scenario1.xaml:43 / Scenario2.xaml:53 (verified against the trial's XAML: 2 hits, 0 false positives); after removal, Section 7 smoke launch goes crashed->running and requirements #1/#2 go fail->pass.

items.problem: 0xC0000409 (native fail-fast, no event 1026) has no crash guidance, and Get-CrashSignature reported a red-herring managed exception (REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG from the agent's own unpackaged .exe run) as the cause. The agent burned ~40 turns downgrading the WindowsAppSDK and inspecting the DeploymentManager AutoInitializer.
items.evidence: Get-CrashSignature switch had no 0xc0000409 case (default hint 'read event 1026' is a dead end); session-log turns 4664-4666 report the stale REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG as '.NET: COMException'; turns 5585-5720 show the SDK downgrade rabbit hole.
items.root_cause: The crash-signature knowledge base assumed a managed 1026 always exists, and the 1026 selection had no provenance filter, so a stale unpackaged AutoInitialize artifact was presented as fact.
items.change: Get-CrashSignature now (a) skips 1026 events whose stack is the WindowsAppRuntime DeploymentManager/AutoInitialize (REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG) unpackaged artifact, and (b) has a 0xC0000409 case naming the no-1026 XAML-load-failure class and explicitly discounting the red herring. Matching startup-crashes table row + a red-herring callout added to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md.
items.expected_effect: On any packaged startup fail-fast, the diagnostic points at the startup XAML and tells the agent to ignore the REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG/AutoInitialize frame and not touch the SDK version.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-run Test-AppLaunch on a 0xC0000409 crash: the crash hint reads 'native fail-fast ... XAML LOAD failure ... bisect the startup XAML ... Ignore any REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG / DeploymentManager AutoInitialize frame'; managedType is no longer populated from the unpackaged artifact. Observable: no SDK-version downgrade attempts in the transcript.
